physiology:
The immune system is where this code lives, and the immune system has only one job: read every cell it meets and decide, in the smallest sliver of a second, whether it belongs. Self or not self. Friend or stranger. Trillions of these readings happen in you every day without your knowing, and the body you wake up in tomorrow is made by how well they go.

The shadow has its floor here, and the floor is more literal than feels comfortable. At the cell, fear shows up as a misread. The same machinery that copies your inner code into the proteins that keep you alive is the machinery that, under enough pressure, copies it wrong. A messenger picks up the instructions, hurries through a body that has been bracing for years, and arrives with the ink smudged. The cell builds what the smudged instruction said to build. Inflammations that will not lift. Susceptibilities. The slow conditions that arrive after a long stretch of giving up. The body believing the world is hostile because the mind has been quietly insisting on it.

The climb out is also at the cell. Reactivity drops. The bracing softens. The readings start coming back clean again. Not because you have fought anything. Because what is moving through you no longer carries the fear it was carrying.

This is the cauldron the old name was pointing at all along. Not a pot. A body, cooking quietly, balancing what is in it.
amino_acid:
The amino acid this code answers to is Glutamic acid, and unlike the one the very first card rests on, the body makes this one for itself. It does not need to be brought in. It is the most abundant amino acid you carry, and in the brain its form, glutamate, is the primary go-signal. The chemistry of one cell telling another to fire, to act, to pass the message along.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the soft centre of this card. The code that hinges on the corruption of messages, on what is lost when something is copied through fear, on a signal smudged in transit, runs at its deepest level on the chemistry of the signal itself. The most carried message in the body is the message this card answers to. The most spoken word in you. Of course it is the one most easily distorted.

Which is why the card keeps returning to the same instruction in different voices. Tune the messenger. Clean what is passing through. The corruption was never in the message. It was in what the body was carrying when it spoke.
